title: Derived termwise global sections with finite evaluation and transition normalization
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and $B_1\leftarrow B_2\leftarrow\cdots$ an inverse sequence of sheaves of commutative rings. Write $\mathscr S(B)$ for strict semilinear systems of module sheaves, with componentwise exactness, identified with modules over $B$ on the sequence site $\mathcal T=\mathcal C\times\mathbf N_{\ge1}$ [lem-pur-system-ringed-sequence-site]. Use unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $A$ be a sheaf of commutative rings with compatible maps $A\to B_n$. Let $U:D(\mathscr S(B))\to D(\operatorname{Tow}(\operatorname{Mod}(A)))$ be exact termwise scalar restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. The termwise global-sections functor on constant-$A$ towers has a total right derived functor $R\Gamma^{\operatorname{Tow}}_{\mathcal C}$, computed by a K-injective resolution in the constant-$A$ tower category [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Consequently $$G=R\Gamma^{\operatorname{Tow}}_{\mathcal C}\circ U:D(\mathscr S(B))\longrightarrow D(\operatorname{Tow}(\operatorname{Ab}))$$ is an actual functor on the ordinary derived category of strict systems. There are specified natural isomorphisms $$e_nG(J)\cong R\Gamma(\mathcal C,\operatorname{Res}_{A\to B_n}J_n)\cong R\Gamma(\mathcal C,J_n),$$ the last expression computed in $B_n$-modules and then regarded as an abelian complex. The first comparison is induced by evaluating the same constant-$A$ tower resolution; the second is the derived direct-image composition comparison for scalar restriction followed by global sections. These isomorphisms intertwine the actual tower transitions with the maps of derived sections induced by $J_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_{B_{n+1}\to B_n}J_n$. They are natural for input derived morphisms. No assertion that varying-ring evaluation preserves K-injectives is made.
